cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE NOT region_id IS NULL LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE region_id IS NOT NULL

cases.sql: SELECT product_name, list_price FROM products WHERE category = %s LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, list_price FROM products WHERE category = '家电'

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= %s AND created_at < %s LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cancelled_order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = %s LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'cancelled'

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS vip_customer_count FROM customers WHERE customer_level = %s LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_level = '钻石'

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = %s LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = '华东'

cases.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.order_status IN (%s, %s, %s) AND o.created_at >= %s AND o.created_at < %s GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('completed','shipped','refunded') AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN (%s, %s, %s) AND o.created_at >= %s AND o.created_at < %s GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 3
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('completed','shipped','refunded') AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 3

cases.sql: SELECT reason, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refunded_at >= %s AND refunded_at < %s GROUP BY reason ORDER BY refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT f.reason, sum(f.refund_amount) FROM refunds f WHERE f.refunded_at >= '2025-01-01' AND f.refunded_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY f.reason

WITH y AS ( SELECT sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) amt, extract(year from o.created_at) yr FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('completed','shipped','refunded') AND extract(year from o.created_at) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY 2)SELECT (SELECT amt FROM y WHERE yr=2025) - (SELECT amt FROM y WHERE yr=2024) AS yoy_diff

cases.sql: SELECT c.country AS country, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customer AS c GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1
cases.gold_sql: SELECT country, count(*) FROM customer GROUP BY country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.sql: SELECT ar.name AS artist_name, SUM(il.quantity) AS tracks_sold FROM invoice_line AS il JOIN track AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN album AS al ON t.album_id = al.album_id JOIN artist AS ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY tracks_sold DESC LIMIT 1
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ar.name, sum(il.quantity) AS sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id JOIN artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id GROUP BY ar.name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 1
